newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CRA Managed raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CRA Managed raised.

text.p: -- Piper Jaffrey said it upgraded CRA Managed Care Inc to strong buy from buy.

-- On Monday, CRA Managed said it acquired Prompt Associates Inc for $30 million in cash. Prompt provides both inpatient and outpatient bill review services to the health care marketplace for claims that fall outside of a payor's network of hospitals or outpatient facilities. Prompt, based in Salt Lake City, Utah, had annual revenues in excess of $10 million for its fiscal year ended December 31, 1995.
-- Piper Jaffrey said Prompt "carries a low-risk profile and substantial upside as integration with existing product lines occur."
